title: Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove that the standard Salvetti complex of every Artin group with finitely many standard generators is aspherical. This resolves the Artin $`K(\pi,1)`$ conjecture in finite rank.
titleEn: Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture

details.overview: 稿件研究有限多个标准生成元的Artin群，证明其标准Salvetti复形是 aspherical 的。摘要表示，这解决了有限秩的Artin K(π,1)猜想。该结果属于几何群论与拓扑学，若成立将为Artin群的分类空间性质提供一般性结论。
keyPoints: 证明有限生成Artin群的标准Salvetti复形是aspherical。
解决有限秩的Artin K(π,1)猜想。
